programs.name: REVIVE Legacy Revival
programs.reward: Proposed equal share: 93,457.943925 RVIV for each of 214 eligible historical wallets; pending approval and claim deployment
programs.eligibility: Historical snapshot membership and verified wallet control, excluding the two removed addresses. No preference based on colour, health, appearance, social role, or past token holdings.
programs.proof: Wallet signature against the published claim challenge after launch; no seed phrase or token transfer.

programs.name: DevCity™ 100
programs.reward: Planned 200,000 RVIV per approved seat; 100 seats maximum
programs.eligibility: Accepted participation, developer evidence and a signed Solana wallet; all 100 accepted seats have equal shares. No identity or appearance preference.
programs.proof: Program approval and signed wallet challenge once a claim flow is published.

programs.name: WorldzLaunchPad™ Contributor Team
programs.reward: 30,000,000 RVIV reserved for approved contributors as a whole; no individual allocation or guaranteed reward yet. Approved future awards use Jupiter Lock over 12 monthly releases.
programs.eligibility: DevCity builders and other supporters may express interest equally. Show real work, choose to join, prove a Solana wallet you control and receive an explicit approved allocation before vesting. No existing title or past token holdings confer a share.
programs.proof: Read the team opening and community contact route. Wallet message signing on Turn Up Town is local only and does not submit an application.

programs.name: Help a Mate • True Support
programs.reward: Community support from the existing OneWorldz impact pool if a specific project and amount are approved; no automatic RVIV grant or promised payment.
programs.eligibility: A person or local group asking for genuine help can share what they need and consent to a fair review. Donations are separate from tokens and do not buy access.
programs.proof: Community evidence and a human review for each published offer; a crypto wallet is not required for ordinary support.

programs.name: Community Support
programs.reward: Support varies by the specific community project; no token reward is promised
programs.eligibility: Each project sets its own eligibility and verification process.
programs.proof: Follow the chosen project's published support pathway; wallet ownership is not required for ordinary donations.
